shared_representation.graph_serialization: UTF-8 of compact JSON array of canonical triples, each triple [subject,predicate,object], preserving deterministic source triple order supplied by the frozen L9 parser; JSON ensure_ascii=false,separators=(',',':').
shared_representation.output_representation: UTF-8 human reference text for training; generated bytes decoded strict UTF-8 with invalid sequences rejected as abstention.
shared_representation.overlength_policy: Do not truncate semantic input. Training examples exceeding either limit are excluded and counted. At audit, overlength input is an explicit abstention with zero semantic coverage.

common_training.final_audit_rule: For GRU and Transformer, fit both mandatory seeds independently. L9_SELECT may choose one checkpoint epoch from {4,8,12} separately for each seed. Both selected seed checkpoints must be evaluated on frozen audit; neither seed may be discarded after audit exposure.
common_training.decoding: greedy only; BOS start; stop at EOS or 512 generated bytes; no beam/search/reranking on audit
common_training.deterministic_flags: seed Python, NumPy if present, and torch; request deterministic algorithms; record any backend operation that cannot satisfy determinism
common_training.selection_metric: lexicographic: maximize SELECT per-triple requested-content coverage; then chrF; then minimize missing triples; then minimize serialized retained model bytes; then lower epoch

CANONICAL_FACTS.output: deterministic triple rendering 'subject predicate object.' in input order

TRAIN_REFERENCE_RETRIEVAL.memory: one canonical graph identity plus shortest normalized training reference per unique graph
TRAIN_REFERENCE_RETRIEVAL.inference: exact graph identity match first; otherwise maximize Jaccard over predicate multiset, then entity-token multiset; deterministic SHA tie-break

COMPOSITIONAL_PATTERN.extraction: For each training triple and each training reference, split reference into punctuation clauses. A clause qualifies only if normalized subject and object strings both occur. Replace the first matched subject/object spans with {S}/{O}; associate resulting clause with normalized predicate.
COMPOSITIONAL_PATTERN.ranking: template support descending, then UTF-8 byte length ascending, then lexical UTF-8 order
COMPOSITIONAL_PATTERN.inference: For each input triple choose top eligible predicate template under selected config, substitute exact subject/object, normalize whitespace, compose in source triple order. If any triple has no eligible template, abstain entire graph. No canonical-fact fallback.

GRU_SEQ2SEQ.framework: PyTorch, from scratch, no pretrained weights/embeddings
GRU_SEQ2SEQ.source: byte embedding -> unidirectional GRU final hidden state
GRU_SEQ2SEQ.decoder: byte embedding -> GRU initialized from encoder hidden -> linear vocab projection

SMALL_TRANSFORMER.framework: PyTorch, from scratch, no pretrained weights/embeddings
SMALL_TRANSFORMER.positional_encoding: fixed sinusoidal, no learned position parameters

implementation_freeze_rule: After this contract commit, implementation source and unit/adversarial tests may be added exactly once before any model fit. Their Git blob identities must then be sealed in an implementation receipt. Any semantic source change after first model fit invalidates L9 and requires a new protocol version.
prefit_qualification: contract schema and split hashes exact
all arm source files import/compile without fitting
parameter-count formulas for GRU and Transformer <= 600000
two mandatory seeds and checkpoint epoch grid are immutable
Linux and Windows focused qualification pass
forbidden: any L9 model fit before implementation receipt is sealed
dropping a mandatory seed after audit exposure
